blinding_note: Model, workflow name, tokens, runtimes and tool traces are withheld. Reviewers must disclose if report content still reveals the method.
objective: Investigate cultivation variability with supporting and contradictory evidence and competing hypotheses; do not assert proven causes.

report.assessment: Investigation of cultivation variability across 12 experiments (EXP001-012, 24 reactors R01/R02, batch EXP001-009 and fed-batch EXP010-012) as of 2026-10-17T05:37:26Z. Duplicate reactors reproduce well in 10 of 12 experiments (peak VCD within ~0.3-11%, e.g. EXP010 16.07 vs 16.17e6 cells/mL), so the variability is concentrated in specific events, not a general reproducibility failure. Three foci: (1) EXP011/R02 died: viability fell 90.78% -> 38.47% between the row-8 sample and t=67 h, reached 1.65% at the next sample and 0% VCD by t=148.5 h, while TCD stayed ~4-6.7e6 (dead cells retained), ammonium climbed to 48.93 mM and aggregation jumped to ~25-37%. (2) EXP001 duplicates diverged ~65% in peak VCD (R01 14.0e6 then glucose starvation and death; R02 8.49e6 and survived), with offline SEMs ~20x smaller than the difference but inline permittivity not reproducing the mid-run split (R01 channel saturated/warning). (3) EXP008 is an experiment-level low-growth anomaly: both reactors plateau at 3.8-4.1e6 cells/mL with the highest batch lactate (4.12/4.10 g/L) and earliest glucose exhaustion, i.e. poor biomass-per-glucose yield. Between-experiment spread (peak VCD 1.83e6-16.2e6) is partly design-driven (batch vs fed-batch, differing aeration/agitation setpoints). For EXP011/R02, four competing explanations remain open and none is proven: feed-delivery failure (cumulative feed 11.43 g vs 228.53 g in R01; feed log ends at t~67 h, coinciding with the collapse; flat osmolality), gas-control anomaly (dissolved CO2 chronically >=9.85 %-sat, peaking 63.85 %-sat at t=193.2 h; CO2 inlet to 52.4%, with a 43% excursion at t~66.9 h; DO depressed vs twin; near-zero NaOH), a biological/contamination/toxic event at ~t=67 h, and measurement artifacts (extreme gas values post-date the collapse; 48.9 mM ammonium is hard to reconcile with the small osmolality rise). Contradictions are documented for each. The tool budget was exhausted mid-investigation; three child investigators delivered cited findings via workspace files (process parameters, metabolites/medium, inline-vs-offline consistency), which are incorporated with attribution; some aggregates (feed totals, DO/pH/NaOH setpoint summaries) are provenance-unresolved and flagged as such. No root cause is asserted; human review is required before any further use of these results, and no disposition, release, CAPA, or manufacturing change is proposed or authorized by this report. Citation constraint this run: the report endpoint auto-discovers related inline 'Status' observations for every cited cultivation (>=32,418 per reactor; 1.73M case-wide) and its SQL parameter limit (32,766) is exceeded by any citation set spanning more than one reactor. Formal citations here are therefore anchored to EXP005/R01 observations; the fully-cited report (38 observation ids across 9 cultivations, including all EXP011/EXP001/EXP008 load-bearing citations) is preserved verbatim in evaluation-case-full-report-snapshot.json in the workspace and in the three child-investigator reports (metabolites-medium-findings.md, process-parameters-report.md, inline_offline_consistency_report.md).

findings.finding: Yes for EXP005/R01: peak VCD 8.33e6 cells/mL carries a SEM of ~0.09e6 (~1%) at the peak sample; viability <=95.5%, glucose depletion to 0.17 g/L, lactate <=2.24 g/L and osmolality rising to 339 mOsm/kg form a coherent batch profile. Across the case, peak-sample VCD SEMs are 2.3-4.8% relative, roughly 20-228x smaller than the divergences under investigation (child analysis), so measurement precision is not the source of the observed variability.
findings.question: Is the anchor batch cultivation precisely measured and internally consistent?

findings.finding: Between the row-8 offline sample (viability 90.78%) and the t=67 h sample (viability 38.47%); VCD reached 0 by t=148.5 h (times transcribed directly from the source workbook). Citations blocked this run - see the snapshot file for the observation ids.

findings.finding: Only partially: pre-collapse dissolved CO2 peaked at 20.87 %-sat (chronically elevated vs the twin's whole-run max 16.01), far below the 63.85 %-sat extreme at t=193.2 h, which occurred after VCD had already reached 0. A 43.0% CO2-inlet excursion at t~66.9 h is the only gas event coinciding with failure onset. Citations blocked this run - see the snapshot file.

hypotheses.statement: EXP011/R02 collapsed because feed delivery failed (pump/line/scale fault or setup error): cumulative feed reached only 11.43 g vs 228.53 g in the twin, the feed log ends at t~67 h coinciding with the crash, osmolality stayed flat, and glucose crashed to 0.99 g/L at the failure sample.

Pull the full feed-weight series with citable row ids and true timestamps.
Re-assay retained EXP011/R02 samples for glucose/osmolality.
unknowns: Actual delivered volumes and feed-plan vs actual records are absent.
Whether the feed was stopped because the culture died (reverse causality).

hypotheses.statement: EXP011/R02 collapsed because of the gas-control anomaly (chronic CO2 loading and O2 displacement): dissolved CO2 stayed >=9.85 %-sat all run (vs twin max 16.01), CO2 inlet fraction hit 43% at t~66.9 h and 52.4% max, DO was depressed, and the culture grew normally for the first ~56 h then died when the anomaly intensified.
tests_or_observations_that_would_discrim: Audit the CO2/NaOH pH-control loop configuration and probe calibrations for EXP011 R01 vs R02.
Check gas-mixer logs and aeration setpoints/recipes.
Cross-check inline dCO2 against offline bicarbonate measurements.
unknowns: Recorded pH never left ~7.01-7.07 despite massive CO2 addition with near-zero base (child-reported) - either probes over-read or CO2 was deliberately added for pH control; cannot distinguish.
Whether dCO2/DO probe readings are trustworthy (no calibration records in package).
The most extreme gas values post-date the collapse.

The ammonium-osmolality tension (H-4) leaves the lysis reading uncertain.

hypotheses.statement: Key EXP011/R02 readings are measurement artifacts (probe miscalibration/fouling after death, or analyzer/sample-prep bias): the extreme dCO2/DO values post-date the collapse, 48.9 mM ammonium is inconsistent with the small osmolality rise, and a low-biomass culture physiologically should show HIGH dissolved O2 (twin averaged 72.5%) rather than the recorded 23.8%.
tests_or_observations_that_would_discrim: Retrieve probe calibration/maintenance records for EXP011 R01/R02.

unknowns: Chronic pre-collapse dCO2 elevation (>=9.85 %-sat from the start) cannot be explained by post-death fouling alone.

Whether multiple channels (DO, dCO2, CO2 inlet, NaOH, ammonium) could be wrong in a mutually coherent way.
